Researching your planned career’s average starting salary, as well as the state of the job market, can help you get a general idea of what you might earn.

This generally involves recognizing situations and emotions that seem to encourage spontaneous spending and learning to navigate them.

## Breaking down Chase Ultimate Rewards®
If you’re a Chase cardmember, you may have access to Chase Ultimate Rewards, an online dashboard where you can utilize Shop and Earn. This is Chase’s online shopping portal where you can shop and earn bonus points with hundreds of retailers. Note that you must be a cardmember with Freedom®, Sapphire® or Ink® card products to access Ultimate Rewards and Shop and Earn.
